description: Source code implementing TLS (Transport Layer Security) support for Redis, including context creation, connection handling, event management, and OpenSSL integration.

classes.name: tls_connection
classes.description: Represents a TLS connection, including SSL object, connection state, error info, and pending list node.

methods.name: createSSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSL_CTX with provided configuration, setting certificates, ciphers, and protocols.

methods.name: tlsInit
methods.description: Initializes OpenSSL library, sets up locking callbacks if needed, and prepares for TLS operations.

methods.name: tlsCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up OpenSSL contexts and resources.

methods.name: tlsConfigure
methods.description: Configures TLS contexts based on provided configuration, including certificates, protocols, and DH parameters.

methods.name: connCreateTLS
methods.description: Creates a new TLS connection object.

methods.name: connCreateAcceptedTLS
methods.description: Creates a TLS connection object associated with an accepted socket descriptor.

methods.name: connTLSAccept
methods.description: Performs TLS handshake acceptance on a connection.

methods.name: connTLSConnect
methods.description: Initiates a TLS connection to a remote address.

methods.name: connTLSRead
methods.description: Reads data from a TLS connection.

methods.name: connTLSWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a TLS connection.

methods.name: connTLSSetReadHandler
methods.description: Sets the read event handler for a TLS connection.

methods.name: connTLSSetWriteHandler
methods.description: Sets the write event handler for a TLS connection.

methods.name: connTLSGetLastError
methods.description: Retrieves the last SSL error message for a connection.

methods.name: connTLSGetPeerCert
methods.description: Fetches the peer certificate in PEM format from a TLS connection.
